sources.evidence: Cementos Progreso's official current site identifies the company as Cementos Progreso, S.A.; its current plants page identifies active cement and clinker production plants in Guatemala.
The official current plants page identifies Planta San Gabriel as a cement-production plant in Guatemala producing clinker and hydraulic cements.
UNACEM's current legal terms identify UNACEM PERÚ S.A. as the legal entity and list Planta Atocongo in Lima.
UNACEM's 2026-published ISO 37001 certificate identifies UNACEM PERÚ S.A. and certifies clinker and cement manufacturing at Planta Industrial Atocongo.
INC's official legal-creation page reproduces Law 126/69 establishing the autonomous legal entity Industria Nacional del Cemento with its own legal personality and assets.
INC's current official site states its mission is to produce cement and identifies its industrial plants at Vallemí and Villeta.
